警視廳統計書 1940

Keishichō tōkeisho (Statistical Report of the Metropolitan Police Board), 第50回, 昭和15年 (1940)
警視廳 (Metropolitan Police Board), 東京, 1942 (昭和17年刊行)

All 260 numbered tables are transcribed; the printed contents are given as the table of contents (its right edge is cut off in the scan, so some page numbers there are missing), and the chapter dividers are not reproduced. Each spread was read once by Claude Sonnet 5.5 from full-resolution crops, with no checking by eye; three long lists (private hospitals, arrests by offence, summary judgments by offence) were read in sections by several readers and joined. Two tables whose totals failed in suspicious patterns were read again and found to be printed that way. Where a 3 could be an 8 and only one reading makes the printed total reconcile — the cell being the only doubtful one in that sum — that reading is used and noted. Printed totals that do not add up are kept as printed and noted. 108 of about 223,000 filled cells could not be read and are marked [?].
